caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, ornamental border, a standing bodhisattva beneath a flower-strewn canopy preaching to a small devotee, attendants with banners and a jewelled altar, scrolling cloud bands and striped drapery on a red ground, cinnabar red, malachite green, azurite blue, ochre, jade white
notes_zh: 敦煌绢画《观音说法图》(Met CC0 74906)：红地华盖、幡幢、云气卷草。
